messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem 1: recurring stale-stream disconnects and partial output observed across chat endpoints during 2026-04-05 08:00-10:15 UTC. Pattern: long-running generations (>20s) then upstream proxy issues RST_STREAM/GOAWAY. Need a short, owned remediation plan with dates.

lee: saw it in traces. Tail token churn leads to no outbound frames for long periods. Short-term: emit small keepalive frames or micro-chunk flushes. Medium: SDK resume + jittered reconnect.

sagar: Envoy logs confirm RST_STREAM with reason=idle_timeout on long requests. Snippet:
```
2026-04-05T08:17:02Z proxy=envoy event=RST_STREAM reason=idle_timeout req=0x7f2a duration=21.8s
```
No app-level keepalive during token-gen.

rachel: Product metrics show ~8% drop in chat completions for affected cohorts. We should prioritize routes that serve live-assist.

toni: Draft action items (owners + ETA):
- P1: Edge idle-timeout canary (short bump to 75s) + watchlist (per-region) 1 owner: ops 1 due: 2026-04-06
- P2: Runtime micro-chunk flush / HTTP/2 PING keepalive (staging) 1 owner: sagar 1 due: 2026-04-09
- P3: Client SDK resume cursor + exp backoff + randomized jitter (integration tests + canary flag) 1 owner: lee 1 due: 2026-04-12
- P4: Observability: `stream.partial_chunk_count` + `stream.partial_rate` (labels: model, region, route) + pager threshold 1 owner: rachel 1 due: 2026-04-07
- P5: Action tracker doc + weekly sync until stable 1 owner: maria 1 cadence/due: weekly, first sync 2026-04-08 09:00 UTC

maria: I'll create the shared checklist and calendar invite. Please update the doc when you start work.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-5209 "stale-stream disconnect canary" assigned to ops-oncall. Link: https://tickets/INF-5209

lee: I'll open SDK branch tonight. Plan: include idempotent resume cursor and a toggled canary build for Dedicated customers. PR ETA: 2026-04-06.

sagar: I'll prototype micro-chunk flush and PINGs in staging this week. Early experiment reduced resets from ~11/hr to ~2/hr in a synthetic harness. PR link forthcoming.

rachel: I'll add the metrics and a dashboard tile; will tune pager sensitivity to avoid noisy alerts during canary.

maria: Ops: can we get a low-traffic one-hour window for the canary on 2026-04-06 02:00-03:00 UTC? If not, do rolling per-region.

ops-bot: ops-oncall accepted canary window 2026-04-06 02:00-03:00 UTC and added rollback steps to INF-5209.

lee: Note: SDK resume requires monotonic resume cursor and replay guard to avoid duplicate application events. We'll include harness tests.

sagar: Also recommend adding a histogram for chunk-intervals to help distinguish partial-chunk progress vs abrupt aborts.

maria: Summary: P1/P2 asap (48-72h), P3/P4 next sprint, weekly sync starting 2026-04-08. Update checklist and report blockers here. Closing thread for now 44D
